sequence: Read AGENTS.md, README.md, WORK_QUEUE.md and WORK_QUEUE.lock again; verify the lock token belongs to this VF umbrella.
Preflight processes/listeners/containers, GPU identity, disk free space and exact candidate presence/hash. Do not stop unrelated processes.
Shallow clone the vendor GitLab repository and checkout the exact source commit; independently grep actual type names, qwen4exp and CUDA backend paths.
Only if static checks pass, configure/build llama-server with GGML_CUDA=ON and CUDA arch 86, with source/build on D.

If both devices appear, amend Q152 and proceed sequentially with its exact candidate/checksum, two-GPU load and BCB-Hard-8 screen. Otherwise stop, preserve receipts and clean only Q160-owned build/source.
expectedFirstOutcome: Either CUDA server enumerates both RTX 3090s, enabling amended Q152, or the runtime remains blocked before model download.
